articles.title: Vy Spine Announces FDA Clearance for VyBrate VBR System
articles.mainIdea: Vy Spine Announces FDA Clearance for VyBrate VBR System
articles.summary: Business Wire: Vy Spine Announces FDA Clearance for VyBrate VBR System. BOUNTIFUL, Utah, January 13, 2026--Vy Spine, a spine innovation leader using differentiated materials and designs, announced today that it has received 510(k) clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for its VyBrate VBR System which is designed for use in both the cervical and thoracolumbar spine for vertebral body replacement surgery.
